explanation: Generated a valid single-point eta-channel EXCLURAD input at W=1.700 GeV, Q2=1.000 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, phi*=90 deg. The requested vcut=-0.1 was kept as requested. In this codebase, negative vcut is allowed, but it changes the meaning of the cut: it applies a cut on v directly rather than on v^2, so results are not directly comparable to the standard eta setup that uses positive vcut=0.166 GeV^2. The point itself is within the documented eta-channel kinematic range. The code was not run here because this environment has no compiler or shell.
